concerns.text: T011r is tagged [P] yet has an explicit dependency on T010r, and the closing note ('[P] with respect to T009r documentation-wise but sequenced after T010r for content') is self-contradictory: a task with a hard content dependency on T010r is not parallel-safe in the usual sense. Clarify what T011r is parallel WITH (e.g., it may run alongside any Phase-2 polish but must follow T010r), or drop the [P] tag.
